subject: Your Support Strengthens the Church's Voice in the Culture
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Dear Fellow American,

As a disciple of Jesus Christ, I know the
disturbing reality we face - a godless, "Woke" culture that is
ACTIVELY ATTACKING the Christian foundations of our nation.

This is a time of grave concern as we witness the
rise of anti-biblical ideologies that seek to undermine the
inerrancy of Scripture and the traditional values that have long
defined the American way of life.

But TPUSA Faith is on the front lines, standing
firm in our unwavering commitment to equip pastors,
congregations, and believers to be bold voices for biblical truth
in the public arena.

Our Freedom Night in America series is a powerful
tool that brings in guest speakers to engage in crucial
discussions on the most pressing issues of our day - from
sexuality and gender to family life and religious liberty.

With your financial support of $35, $50, $100,
$250, or $500, TPUSA Faith can continue hosting these vital
events, strengthening the Church and defending our God-given
liberty.

You see, the opposition's agenda is clear - they
seek to erase our Christian heritage, silence the pulpit, and
impose a secular, humanistic worldview that is antithetical to
the teachings of Scripture.

BUT WE WILL NOT BE SILENCED.

TPUSA Faith is dedicated to equipping believers to
live out their faith boldly, challenge the secular culture, and
uphold the inerrancy of Scripture.

Support TPUSA Faith Freedom Nights

With your support, we can empower pastors and
congregations to stand firm in their convictions, engage the
public square with confidence, and reclaim the narrative that has
been hijacked by those who seek to undermine our most sacred
values.

As inheritors of a rich Christian legacy, we have a
sacred duty to defend the faith and restore America's foundation
on biblical principles.

So, I urge you - please donate $25, $50, $75, or
more TODAY to help us sponsor more of these Freedom Nights and
share the message of biblical truth far and wide.

Together, we can stand against the forces of
darkness, a shining light in a world that desperately needs to
hear the timeless truths of God's Word.

Support TPUSA Faith Freedom Nights

Join us in this vital mission to defend the faith,
challenge the culture, and reclaim America for Christ.

God bless you,

Charlie Kirk

name: Cori Bush
subject: My fight for reproductive freedom is personal
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fight for Progress PAC and not authorized by any candidate or any candidate's committee
body:
At 17, I was assaulted and then had an abortion. It was devastating.
I was devastated again 30 years later when Republican extremists overturned Roe v. Wade.
But I’ve turned my hurt into action: defending access to abortion care, organizing to expand the Supreme Court, and working with President Biden to protect abortion rights. For me, the fight for our reproductive freedoms is personal – and urgent.
I recently released a new campaign ad that tells my story and underscores my unwavering commitment to defend our rights at every level – especially given the far-right’s relentless attacks on our reproductive freedoms. Take a look here: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-ffp-q3-2024-coribush?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-08_1&amount=25]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-ffp-q3-2024-coribush?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-08_1&amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-ffp-q3-2024-coribush?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-08_1&amount=25]
In 2022, Missouri became the first state to enact its extreme abortion ban after the far-right Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe . More than ever, we need a reproductive champion who will stand firm and fight back.
I am that champion. I am at the forefront of our fight to enshrine gender equality into the Constitution — including our right to bodily autonomy — by finally publishing the Equal Rights Amendment. As the co-founder and co-chair of the Equal Rights Amendment Caucus and the proud lead sponsor of the ERA Now Resolution, I know a better future is possible. I am the ONLY candidate in this race to be endorsed by leading reproductive and abortion rights organizations, including Planned Parenthood Action Fund, Abortion Action Missouri, and Reproductive Freedom For All (formerly NARAL).
My opponent, on the other hand, is a former Republican campaign manager for an anti-abortion extremist who ran for this very seat. Now, he is being bankrolled by anti-abortion Republicans, including those who spearheaded Missouri’s extreme abortion ban. Peter, St. Louis is not for sale, and reproductive freedom is not something to bet on.
Now, more than ever, we need your support. This fight is not just about one election; it’s about our fundamental rights and freedoms. Will you join me and Fight For Progress by splitting a contribution to our campaigns today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-ffp-q3-2024-coribush?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-07-08_1&amount=25]
Your support will ensure we can continue to defend our reproductive rights and fight for justice in Washington. Thank you for standing with us.
In solidarity,
Cori Bush

**A Message from Senator John Barrasso:**

[](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5ca9773ed93943928dc2c8e6f5f93866&_e=WxiwcZOendZ3GzL1_dehIJJmNGUSJd8k09Hw92Ww4mf_xwYaa409RQI4HFf0TptGWbTgwA0hNo8lov1yGCJY3VcS2ZOhoCQZBYVOvEwo5exvWGO82cL1UfY9LsiaHKzWIr1nLhziOQH9laMC0YvM5-6QsaQXQhi5NH88XKHA21-ZGRWpjo_ApOI3F93tBHYeDXcYTyHBs0D0CUGpjiicKRx21XTCSuGLRrQ--mikOyxtbhA4BG6CtTa5lNxeYTqnXZq6YNvQtFaWw9QMclJMcQ%3D%3D)
I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5ca9773ed93943928dc2c8e6f5f93866&_e=WxiwcZOendZ3GzL1_dehIJJmNGUSJd8k09Hw92Ww4mf_xwYaa409RQI4HFf0TptGWbTgwA0hNo8lov1yGCJY3VcS2ZOhoCQZBYVOvEwo5exvWGO82cL1UfY9LsiaHKzWTgHD33kTcvnNSazDH6xny9xr4LSLpviQJ77C2_vg4gOh2oxEpkZptW93IXL2S1fjcBZVkkMGeZmznGiChTFTvUquLwB-M2O_aeZBXIn_XwZx7hHhQvtKOR_wYIP69BRriTKtRnvqvx-lxYuQNLg-ew%3D%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5ca9773ed93943928dc2c8e6f5f93866&_e=WxiwcZOendZ3GzL1_dehIJJmNGUSJd8k09Hw92Ww4mf_xwYaa409RQI4HFf0TptGWbTgwA0hNo8lov1yGCJY3VcS2ZOhoCQZBYVOvEwo5exvWGO82cL1UfY9LsiaHKzWszFQwUKykfUwze5nXNS6M8AxqkgcV_S2HBOEBMbCmnsrlk76wD0t_bbRZzDyhvWgyEcwQLZnCCcqek7Pb_slVCC6Hcahm7S-J0AuK5UM1bKSUyQW6a8JsQ8UhgnYQfNuT8vBNWaFALJa-KOri3qMhA%3D%3D)

Their dedication and sacrifice deserve our recognition and thanks, no matter the time of year. That's why we're creating a special thank you card to show our appreciation to our service members. Your words will mean the world to those who selflessly serve our country. Thank you for helping us show our soldiers how much they are valued and appreciated. \- Team Barrasso A Message from Senator John Barrasso: I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state. My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty. From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming. Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving. As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as "Wyoming's doctor," but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be. Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations. As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. ** Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families. name: Ilhan Omar
subject: Will you add your name to personally endorse my campaign for Congress today?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1222%2E791427%2EcQ52e9)

Hey team, it's Ilhan. I'm writing to ask you to **[add your name to say you personally endorse my campaign for Congress in Minnesota's 5th district,**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july24-personal-endorse/?source=em240708-1&refcode2=1222.791427.cQ52e9&akid=1222%2E791427%2EcQ52e9) but before I explain why your support today is so important to our movement, let me start at the very beginning.
Now, one thing you may know about my story is that I am a refugee.
When I was just a young child, my family was forced to escape civil war in Somalia and take sanctuary in a Kenyan refugee camp for four years.
We didn't always have food, or running water. But we did have a dream that one day, we would be able to get out of that camp and start a new life in the United States.
At the time, I couldn't have imagined that someday, I would run for office in a new country, nevermind become the first African-born member of Congress, or that tens of thousands of people would stand with me along the way.
When I got to Washington, my colleagues and the political establishment told me that I was destined to fail, and that two years later we'd run again and lose. They said a Somali, Muslim, hijab-wearing, Black progressive woman couldn’t enact change in an institution with rules not created for us.
But we did not back down. We fought hard for our ideas. We forced climate action to the top of the agenda. We empowered Medicare to finally negotiate prescription drug prices. We made justice in all its forms a priority.
Then we ran again, and won. And once more after that, for good measure.
But the truth is, we still have a great deal of work ahead of us. The insiders and special interests who never wanted me in Congress are going to come back with more money and resources than ever before to try to take me down here in 2024.
**I know that I cannot fight back against them alone. That is something that is going to require ALL of us.**
**[So I'm asking you to stand with me today. Will you add your name to personally endorse our re-election campaign? Building this movement is something we must all do together.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july24-personal-endorse/?source=em240708-1&refcode2=1222.791427.cQ52e9&akid=1222%2E791427%2EcQ52e9)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july24-personal-endorse/?source=em240708-1&refcode2=1222.791427.cQ52e9&akid=1222%2E791427%2EcQ52e9)**
When I was first elected to Congress in 2018, our ideas were called radical:
* 🏥 Medicare for All
* 🌅 A Green New Deal
* 📈 Raising the Minimum Wage
* 🎓 Canceling Student Debt
* ❌ Banning Assault Weapons

Together, our progressive movement made these ideas mainstream. We demanded an economy that works for the many, not the few. All of us — and especially young people — deserve a country that lives up to her promise of justice for all.
There’s no doubt that these ideas have put a constant target on me from Republicans and their corporate allies. The DC insiders and special interests that thrive on the status quo have come after me nonstop. Every two years, they recruit another challenger who will fall in line with their agenda, and their super PACs flood my district with millions of dollars in dark money to try to silence all of us.
They are already preparing to do it again here in 2024. Right-wing groups like AIPAC and their United Democracy super PAC have committed to spending _$100 million_ nationwide interfering in Democratic primaries.
But I didn’t come to Congress to be silent. I came to Congress to be a voice for you. For working families. For little girls like me. And for those who have felt ignored or silenced for too long.
**Today, I need you to add your voice to mine as we prepare for the fights ahead. What do you say?**
**[Please use this link and add your name to personally endorse our re-election for Congress today. I need as many people as possible to stand with me in this campaign.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july24-personal-endorse/?source=em240708-1&refcode2=1222.791427.cQ52e9&akid=1222%2E791427%2EcQ52e9)**
It may seem like a small and simple action, but it speaks volumes about our collective power. Thank you for signing on today.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july24-personal-endorse/?source=em240708-1&refcode2=1222.791427.cQ52e9&akid=1222%2E791427%2EcQ52e9)

For the past week and a half, the media has intensely focused election coverage on President Biden’s debate performance.

We can’t let that happen Peter, For the past week and a half, the media has intensely focused election coverage on President Biden’s debate performance. The New York Times called for Biden to drop out of the race, and virtually every legacy media outlet is airing 24/7 speculation about the future of his campaign. At the same time, the same networks are building an utterly false counter-narrative about Donald Trump: that he’s somehow running a “disciplined” campaign. = So has Trump suddenly become a disciplined, focused campaigner in the last ten days? Absolutely not. The proof is in Trump’s Truth Social account. Just take a look at some of the recent posts he’s shared with his millions of right-wing followers in the last ten days: He called on Liz Cheney, the former Congresswoman who headed the January 6 committee, to be tried on charges of treason in a televised military tribunal. He called for dozens of his “political enemies,” including former Vice President Mike Pence, to be jailed. He posted support for Steve Bannon, who is currently in jail for contempt of Congress. According to the legacy press – that’s disciplined and “quiet.” See for yourself: = At least the New York Times qualified their analysis with “relatively.” However, it does make you wonder how many authoritarian threats a presidential candidate needs to make these days before the media bats an eye. Here at COURIER, we’re not afraid to set aside the outdated “both sides” method of election coverage and speak the truth: Donald Trump is making authoritarian threats that divide our country and create the same conditions that led to the violence we saw on January 6th. Peter, the bad news is that if the media keeps normalizing Trump’s authoritarianism, our democracy may never recover. But the good news is that COURIER is working around the clock to call out dangerous bias and misinformation in the media. body:

I hope you had a fantastic Independence Day weekend!
Team Morse kicked off July 4th in Wolfeboro for the Winnipesaukee GOP Breakfast. I enjoyed meeting Granite Staters from the Lakes Region and sharing my vision for New Hampshire. name: Charity Barry
subject: Dane County GOP Vice Chair Engages in Political Lawfare and Election Interference
body:
Politics can be dirty, but this crosses all lines
| | | |
---
---
| This is Unacceptable!
---
---
| While I am appalled at the necessity of writing such a message, I can not stand by and watch this level of corruption go unaccounted for. To risk the life of a child in political revenge is despicable and unnatural, and the blatant interference in my primary election from a fellow Republican is sickening and must be called out for what it is -
Lawfare and Election Interference
---
| My Official Statement
---
---
| It has come to my attention that many rumors are being spread about myself and my family, most notably that I am being investigated by the FBI. I am not, nor have I ever been investigated by the FBI, nor has my family.
These rumors were initiated by Chrissi Illgen, Navin Jarugumilli, and others as political retribution toward me and my candidacy. In fact, Chrissi Illgen has personally engaged in lawfare and election interference by making reports and false allegations to several agencies, including the FBI.
On Sunday, May 26th, Chrissi Illgen used a burner email address to send an anonymous request to the Iowa County Sheriff's Office for a welfare check on my little brother, whom she had not seen since at least early April. On Wednesday, May 29th, Chrissi continued with an email to social services, making false claims.
On June 4th, she requested an update from the Iowa County Sheriff's Department, and after being professionally told there were no further details to be given, Chrissi decided to take her slander to the next level and contact the FBI with her false allegations.
According to the Iowa County Sheriff's Department, "The FBI does not investigate but makes the local jurisdiction aware to take the proper action...". On Friday, May 31st, an Iowa County Detective and Social Worker did just that and came to our home to perform the requested welfare check. They observed my brother for two and a half hours, after which they stated that, "No concerns were noted."
Additionally, in contradiction to what Chrissi falsely told law enforcement, the detective stated among other things that my brother "is not failing to thrive", "is not pale", "engaged in conversation", "appeared comfortable", and "did not appear pale, lethargic, malnourished, starving, or sickly in any way", etc. In short, they observed a happy child thriving in a healthy environment.
"No concerns were noted by [the detective] or Social Services" and it was recommended "to close the case as unfounded."
My family was completely cooperative with law enforcement through this process, and I am thankful for the thorough and objective analysis by our Iowa County Sheriff's Department that came to the truth.
The question then begs to be answered, why would Chrissi Illgen, the Vice Chair of the Republican Party of Dane County (RPDC), make such a slanderous report, and why would Navin Jarugumilli, Secretary of RPDC, and others choose to spread the lies?
In February 2023, I supported Chrissi in her successful campaign for Vice Chair of RPDC, fully believing in her message and stated plan for action, but a few months into her new role, it became clear that Chrissi and others in leadership were unable to handle constructive input or accountability from other elected board members or volunteers to the point of handicapping the organization. This year, she chose to run for RNC Committeewoman at the RPW Convention in May and lost.
On May 18, 2024, I chose not to vote for Chrissi because I believed that her disdain for many volunteers, inability to accept opinions other than her own, lack of professionalism and emotional stability in and out of the board room, and vindictive nature (i.e. promoting the removal, ostracization, or character attacks of certain board members and volunteers that did not completely align with her point of view) would cause incredible levels of damage if elevated to the state and national levels.
I kept my decision private leading up to the election, but with only one other delegate present from my home county, I was appointed acting chair and put in the position of announcing my vote against Chrissi to the entire convention.
While some have said it would have been more politically astute to "hold my nose and vote for Chrissi", her actions confirm that I made the best decision for the people of Wisconsin. Not only is Chrissi willing to go after her perceived political opposition when she doesn't win, but she has proven she will stop at no moral lengths to satisfy her desire for revenge. Chrissi was willing to put the life of a child at risk in an attempt to punish me politically.
My "little brother" came to us from an abusive home. For the first part of his life, he was neglected, starved, and abused by his biological mother and those she chose to associate with, some of whom were not legally allowed to be in the presence of minors. One of her sons was recently shot and killed by a "family friend" in gang activity. In those years living in a traumatic environment, he was affected in ways that Chrissi Illgen could never imagine. He and those of us who love him most deal with those issues on a daily basis, but he is growing by leaps and bounds that have surpassed doctor's and specialist's expectations and is now thriving in a loving home, as noted by the detective.
Immediately following Chrissi's lost election, it became clear that my vote and influence were being blamed for the outcome. It was one week later that she made her first "report." In some of her complaints to law enforcement, Chrissi cited up to four sources, none of which are credible or pertinent.
The first source was a criminal complaint/pathologist's report involving the tragic death of a child staying in our home in 2018. While it was reasonable for questions to be asked, the pathologist involved had a history of false accusations and was properly discredited at trial where it was determined that the girl did not pass away from any outside injuries. The jury agreed in May of 2022, finding my mother and sister not guilty. Chrissi knew about the trial and had supported me until now.
The second and third sources cited had serious documented mental health issues and history of criminal behavior. They had both attempted to cause drama during my family's trial in 2022 by contacting the Sheriff's Office, the prosecuting District Attorney, and the media, but after multiple interviews, were deemed not credible and irrelevant.
Chrissi's fourth stated source was a former colleague of mine with a criminal record he lied about during his time working with me, an erratic mental health history, and whose lack of ability to control himself threatened the physical safety of myself and others, forcing our contact to end. He has not seen my little brother at all in nearly two years, and he was protectively never given close contact with him. This individual is a mandated reporter and was at the time that he last saw my brother. If he had any founded concerns regarding the safety of a child, he would have been legally required to report them at that time.
While Chrissi claims to be vetting me as a candidate, she has failed to vet her own sources of slander. She also had Robert Relph, Candidate for the 80th Assembly District, call his own connections in Iowa County to bring her accusations. Robert admitted he had no firsthand knowledge and only regurgitated Chrissi's false claims. Chrissi Illgen is a large donor to Republican candidates and has hosted a fundraiser for Robert in the past.
Since Chrissi began, she and others in her circle have personally called my supporters, falsely stating that there is an investigation by the FBI but not revealing that she is the source. No one spreading these lies has approached me directly with their alleged concerns. She has also begun to publicly support my primary opponent. After signing my nomination papers in April, Chrissi began circulating nomination papers for him one week after the vote; she also seated him with her and the featured guest at the head table during a major RPDC fundraiser on June 7th. This behavior is in complete contradiction to her past statements of her opinion of my opponent or our race.
Navin Jarugumilli has joined Chrissi in spreading these lies to many individuals, following them to their vehicles after events and referring to me by vulgar and profane names. Navin was also aware of all accusations concerning my family during the period of the trial but had supported me up until my vote in May, even to the point of endorsing my would-be candidacy in writing against my primary opponent in March of 2023.
This level of corruption and willingness to risk the physical and mental safety and wellbeing of a child for personal vengeance is unacceptable. It is imperative that this be addressed. Chrissi and those who have gone along with her in this or known and not put a stop to her actions - Navin, Robert, and others I have not named - do not have the character to hold any positions of leadership within the Republican Party.
My goal is not to cause division or cast a shadow on any organization. I do not believe that the actions taken by Chrissi, Navin, Robert, or any others involved bear any representation of the Republican Party or its members at the County, District, or State level. They bear the responsibility for their actions as individuals.
I will never stand by silently and allow injustice like this to occur, regardless of who is committing it, and I will not allow threats, accusations, or bullying to deter me from doing what is right. Whether Republican, Democrat, or otherwise, those who endanger the lives of children must be stopped. And those who engage in political lawfare must be held accountable. I will continue to fight for the free and secure future of our nation.
On to Victory!

If he had any founded concerns regarding the safety of a child, he would have been legally required to report them at that time. While Chrissi claims to be vetting me as a candidate, she has failed to vet her own sources of slander. She also had Robert Relph, Candidate for the 80th Assembly District, call his own connections in Iowa County to bring her accusations. Robert admitted he had no firsthand knowledge and only regurgitated Chrissi's false claims. Chrissi Illgen is a large donor to Republican candidates and has hosted a fundraiser for Robert in the past. Since Chrissi began, she and others in her circle have personally called my supporters, falsely stating that there is an investigation by the FBI but not revealing that she is the source. No one spreading these lies has approached me directly with their alleged concerns. She has also begun to publicly support my primary opponent. After signing my nomination papers in April, Chrissi began circulating nomination papers for him one week after the vote; she also seated him with her and the featured guest at the head table during a major RPDC fundraiser on June 7th. This behavior is in complete contradiction to her past statements of her opinion of my opponent or our race. Navin Jarugumilli has joined Chrissi in spreading these lies to many individuals, following them to their vehicles after events and referring to me by vulgar and profane names. Navin was also aware of all accusations concerning my family during the period of the trial but had supported me up until my vote in May, even to the point of endorsing my would-be candidacy in writing against my primary opponent in March of 2023. This level of corruption and willingness to risk the physical and mental safety and wellbeing of a child for personal vengeance is unacceptable. It is imperative that this be addressed. Chrissi and those who have gone along with her in this or known and not put a stop to her actions - Navin, Robert, and others I have not named - do not have the character to hold any positions of leadership within the Republican Party. My goal is not to cause division or cast a shadow on any organization. I do not believe that the actions taken by Chrissi, Navin, Robert, or any others involved bear any representation of the Republican Party or its members at the County, District, or State level. They bear the responsibility for their actions as individuals. I will never stand by silently and allow injustice like this to occur, regardless of who is committing it, and I will not allow threats, accusations, or bullying to deter me from doing what is right. Whether Republican, Democrat, or otherwise, those who endanger the lives of children must be stopped. And those who engage in political lawfare must be held accountable. I will continue to fight for the free and secure future of our nation. On to Victory! | | | | | == | | | Thank you! | | | Sincerely, Charity Barry Your Candidate for the 2nd Congressional District of WI | | | | == | | | == | == == == | | | | Friends of Charity Barry | PO Box 267 | Mineral Point, WI 53565 US | | | | | |

Democratic lawmakers have started calling for Biden to step aside.

are crafting one of the most dangerous policy agendas in American history:

subject: Why I’m worried about Ohio and Sherrod Brown's race
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC

Friend, Friend, November might be a few months away, but election season is already in full swing. So much is on the line this year, from abortion access to better wages and working conditions to our fundamental right to vote. Future progress on all of these issues depends on protecting our razor-thin Democratic Senate majority – and if we wait until the fall to take action, it’ll already be too late. [**That’s why I’m asking you to support my friend and colleague Sherrod Brown today. Sherrod is in the fight of his life in Ohio, and experts say this race could decide Senate control, so please: Give every dollar you can to split between Sherrod and Serve America to help reelect a true champion for working families.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88496097/484284614/-2003341165?refcode=240708&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MWQ3ODA4Mi02YjNkLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gzMUd6vcLursgKf3QTNZjWVS0OSDxODlw1nsqnfvqqM=) Here’s why I’m so worried about this race: Experts are calling Sherrod one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot, and national Republicans smell blood. They’re already spending millions to flip this seat and the Senate red, and Mitch McConnell’s super PACs just made their largest ad investment EVER to try to take down Sherrod. Now, polls show this race is neck and neck, so Sherrod’s counting on US – you and me, friend – to help him pull ahead. Unlike his wealthy self-funding opponent, Sherrod can’t write his campaign million-dollar checks. That’s why I set a personal goal to raise $75,000 for Sherrod’s campaign by midnight tonight, and I need you to help me get there. If we lose this race, we lose the Senate, plain and simple. With that in mind, will you rush $5 or more to help Sherrod win in Ohio and defend our Senate majority? Thank you. – Chuck Schumer

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
I hope you had a great 4th of July weekend. Here’s another update from the campaign trail. | | | | |
---
| Happy Monday!
I hope you had a great 4th of July weekend. Here’s another update from the campaign trail.
**Five Parades on the 4th of July** I spent the 4th of July walking in five parades across Milwaukee County.
We had a great crew and enjoyed seeing thousands of people in Oak Creek, Franklin, Cudahy, St. Francis, and Hales Corners!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| **Joe Biden’s Visit to Wisconsin** Last Friday, Joe Biden visited Madison and attempted to energize his base.
While Democrats are scrambling to unify their party, Republicans are focused on growing the tent and reaching new voters. Voters across Wisconsin understand that the contrast between our pro-growth policies and Biden’s inflationary policies could not be more clear.
I joined Fox and Friends this weekend to discuss Biden’s visit to Wisconsin. Watch the full interview below.
---
[Click Here to Watch My Interview on Fox and Friends!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=5ad3edeb91&e=e907534017)
| **Upcoming Election Integrity Legislation** This week, the House will vote on the The Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, which which would require "documentary proof of United States citizenship" to vote in federal elections.
As the Chairman of the Committee on House Administration, I was proud to pass this bill through our committee in May. Now, we have a chance to pass it on the House floor.
Preventing noncitizen voting and foreign influence in our elections is a critical component of restoring trust in our elections.
---

Bryan Steil

_
I was in Montana recently to rally support for Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy as he campaigns to unseat Jon Tester._

When I found out Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy was running for Senate in Montana, I knew I needed to help this decorated warfighter and true patriot defeat the Washington establishment incumbent, Jon Tester.

| | This is an exciting moment for Fair Fight. Last month, Fair Fight announced their updated volunteer recruitment program — they’re cutting through the noise and letting extremists know that this democracy is ours. Across the country, we’re seeing systematic attempts by Republicans to marginalize voters of color and entrench their political power:
* The Supreme Court upheld a racially gerrymandered congressional map that diluted the voices of voters of color
* In May here in Georgia, Governor Brian Kemp returned to his voter-suppression roots with the signing of SB189: an escalation of his consistent assault on voting rights. This legislation went into effect July 1 and is expected to disenfranchise Black and brown voters, seniors and Georgia’s unhoused population.

We also expect to see a rise in mass voter purges over the coming months as extremists wield false claims and misinformation to try to stop us from heading to the ballot box. **But we must continue to fight.** Fair Fight knows it will take a full-scale organizing effort to push back against anti-voter attacks and ensure free and fair elections — that’s why you’re a part of our movement, and I couldn’t be more grateful. Our democracy depends on ensuring every voice is heard, and every vote counts. We can't allow these manipulative, corrosive tactics to go unchallenged. We will meet them in the courts and at the polls. When we have the freedom to take our seat at the table and our place at the ballot box, we can elect leaders who govern in our interests, ensure every voice is heard and make the promise of democracy real for us all. This is our fight — thank you for showing up. This legislation went into effect July 1 and is expected to disenfranchise Black and brown voters, seniors and Georgia’s unhoused population. We also expect to see a rise in mass voter purges over the coming months as extremists wield false claims and misinformation to try to stop us from heading to the ballot box. But we must continue to fight. Fair Fight knows it will take a full-scale organizing effort to push back against anti-voter attacks and ensure free and fair elections — that’s why you’re a part of our movement, and I couldn’t be more grateful. Our democracy depends on ensuring every voice is heard, and every vote counts. We can't allow these manipulative, corrosive tactics to go unchallenged. We will meet them in the courts and at the polls. When we have the freedom to take our seat at the table and our place at the ballot box, we can elect leaders who govern in our interests, ensure every voice is heard and make the promise of democracy real for us all. body:
We’re coming up on a huge milestone for Sarah’s campaign.
#
We’re coming up on a _huge_ milestone for Sarah’s campaign. **The filing deadline for the Democratic primary is TOMORROW** , which means we’ll officially know who our opponents are very soon.
Then, it will be a sprint to the finish line, and we’ll be counting on your grassroots support to ensure Sarah wins the primary _and_ the general election in November.
[**So with less than 24 hours until the filing deadline, we’re launching a one-day fundraising goal of $5,000! Can you pitch in $5 now to help us reach it?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240708-1?refcode=em20240708-1-778&amount=5&refcode2=778_21716_kCHm5r&akid=778%2E21716%2EkCHm5r)
Sarah works incredibly hard every single day to hear from her neighbors up and down Delaware. She’s constantly traveling to events, talking to voters, and working out what matters most to the everyday people she’s running to serve.
But running a campaign costs a lot of money.**And Sarah’s already been attacked by MAGA extremists, and we know they’re just getting started.**
Here’s where your grassroots donations come in: The more we raise from emails like this one, the less Sarah has to worry about fundraising. As Finance Director, I want to make sure she gets to spend as much time out there with voters as possible — but I need your help!

body:
| | |
---
# **July 8th Newsletter**

---
Dear neighbors,
---
I hope you had a wonderful 4th of July, celebrating with family and friends! As we reflect on last week's festivities, let's take a moment to remember the history and significance of this important day in American history. Independence Day, also known as the Fourth of July, commemorates the adoption of the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776, declaring the original 13 American colonies as a new nation, the United States of America. The day is often associated with fireworks, parades, barbecues, carnivals, fairs, picnics, concerts, baseball games, family reunions, and ceremonies, as well as various other public and private events celebrating the history, government, and traditions of the United States.
---
| |
---
| This year, much like years in the past, I joined thousands of residents for the annual Dale City parade and family fun day hosted by the Dale City Civic Association. Fun Fact: The nearly 2-mile Dale City parade is believed to be the longest Independence Day parade and arguably the most well-attended in the Commonwealth of Virginia. If you missed this year's parade, there is always next year. The parade has existed for over 50 years and shows no signs of stopping. See you next year!
---
| | As you continue to read this week’s newsletter, you will find the latest updates regarding the [Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88498739/484294053/1296412208?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzI1ZmI4Mi03NDNkLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q2eeuMfV48r92-poMbXLDTaGAtD7uDx-_Uz8LE5F9P8=&emci=3275aa84-5539-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=9c25fb82-743d-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801), acknowledgment of the history, history, experiences, and achievements of the disability community, new state laws that took effect on July 1st, information regarding the Virginia House of Delegates Page Program, and more.
---
| |
# **Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program**
---
| | **What is the Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program (VMSDEP)? ** The program certifies the eligibility of spouses and dependents of veterans to receive tuition waivers at Virginia public educational institutions. [VMSDEP](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88498740/484294054/1296412208?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzI1ZmI4Mi03NDNkLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q2eeuMfV48r92-poMbXLDTaGAtD7uDx-_Uz8LE5F9P8=&emci=3275aa84-5539-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=9c25fb82-743d-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801) is administered jointly by DVS, which processes applications and determines eligibility, and the State Council of Higher Education for Virginia, which distributes stipends to colleges and universities. Therefore, postsecondary institutions cover the full cost of tuition and fees. **Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission (JLARC) Study:** On Monday, July 1st, the Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission met to receive various presentations. At the end of the meeting, General Assembly members directed JLARC staff to adjust the work program to include an evaluation of all aspects of eligibility criteria and program parameters and back by September 1, 2024. Their findings will include (i) a history of the program; (ii) an analysis of participant data; (iii) validate the waiver costs reported by public higher education institutions; (iv) a review of veteran educational benefits programs in other states and identify best practices; and (v) a review of projections and potential parameters of recommended changes. **Legislative Fix & Next Steps:** On Tuesday, July 2nd, Senate Finance Chair Louise Lucas and House Appropriations Chairman Luke Torian announced their plan to introduce identical legislation ([HB6004](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88498741/484294055/-2100935565?242+ful+HB6004&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzI1ZmI4Mi03NDNkLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q2eeuMfV48r92-poMbXLDTaGAtD7uDx-_Uz8LE5F9P8=&emci=3275aa84-5539-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=9c25fb82-743d-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801) and [SB6012](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88498742/484294056/-2100935565?ses=242&typ=bil&val=SB6012&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzI1ZmI4Mi03NDNkLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q2eeuMfV48r92-poMbXLDTaGAtD7uDx-_Uz8LE5F9P8=&emci=3275aa84-5539-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=9c25fb82-743d-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801)) to repeal changes to the Virginia Military Survivors and Dependents Education Program in the two-year budget. These changes took effect on Monday. Members of the Senate and the House of Delegates will return to Richmond on July 18 to vote on the agreement. Members of the Virginia House of Delegates and the State Senate will return to Richmond on Thursday, July 18, to pass legislation ensuring a full repeal of May 2024 changes to VMSDEP.
---
* * **May 13, 2024 changes which took effect July 1, 2024: **
* Increased funding by $40 million ($20 million each year of the biennium)
* Restricted eligibility to associate and undergraduate degrees;
* Required participants to apply for other forms of financial aid; and
* Tightened residency requirements.
* **July 18, 2024, bill language: **
* Increases VMSDEP funding by $90 million using FY24 surplus funding ($45 million each year of the biennium on top of the $40 million previously allocated in the 2024 biennial state budget); and
* Repeals all noted changes from May 2024 listed above.

---
**My Continued Commitment:** I have spoken with numerous impacted families, many of which call the 25th House District home. While the past few months have been filled with frustration, stress, and anxiety, please find comfort in knowing that I have always stood with our military heroes, first responders, and their families, and will continue to do so. That includes ensuring VMSDEP will continue to be an earned educational benefit for military and veteran families for years to come.
---
# **Disability Pride Month**
---
July is Disability Pride Month, a time to honor and raise awareness about the diversity, history, and culture of the disability community. This month is rooted in the history of the disability rights movement, which advocates for equal rights, accessibility, and inclusion for people with disabilities. The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), which prohibits discrimination against people with disabilities, was signed into law by President George H.W. Bush on July 26, 1990. The first official celebration of Disability Pride Month occurred in July 2015, which also marked the 25th anniversary of the ADA.
---
Disability Pride Month aims to celebrate the accomplishments and contributions of individuals with disabilities while also highlighting the ongoing work needed to break down barriers and promote a more inclusive society. It allows people to come together to recognize the value of every individual, regardless of ability, and to encourage a more equitable and accessible world for all.
---
---
# **New Virginia Laws**
---
On July 1, 2024, 777 bills that were passed during the most recent General Assembly regular session became law. As mentioned in previous newsletters, I have outlined legislation that I sponsored, which has now become law. Here is a [link](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88498743/484294057/-135143439?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzI1ZmI4Mi03NDNkLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q2eeuMfV48r92-poMbXLDTaGAtD7uDx-_Uz8LE5F9P8=&emci=3275aa84-5539-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=9c25fb82-743d-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801) to a list of new laws that will impact your day-to-day life.
---
# **Virginia House of Delegates Page Program**
---
The House Page Program has been running strong since 1847 and is a favorite among Virginia youth aged 13 and 14. Held each winter at the historic Virginia State Capitol and General Assembly Building in Richmond, Virginia, the program aims to prepare students for active citizenship. It also provides participants with a firsthand look at the lawmaking process. It's a fantastic opportunity for students to enhance their leadership skills, develop workplace abilities, and contribute to our democracy. In the coming weeks, I will share program details for the 2025 General Assembly session as information becomes available.
---
# **Community Events**
---
**Thursday, July 11:** Experience the magic of the "President's Own" U.S. Marine Band as they deliver a captivating birthday concert at the National Museum of the Marine Corps. From traditional concert band masterpieces to challenging orchestral transcriptions, and stirring patriotic marches, the band's performances are a testament to their unparalleled skill and artistry. You won’t want to miss the opportunity to attend the free Summer Concerts on the museum's entry plaza, weather permitting. Click [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88498744/484294058/-651070647?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzI1ZmI4Mi03NDNkLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q2eeuMfV48r92-poMbXLDTaGAtD7uDx-_Uz8LE5F9P8=&emci=3275aa84-5539-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=9c25fb82-743d-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801) to learn more. **Friday, July 12:** The Prince William County “[Fridays at 5](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88498745/484294059/328562898?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzI1ZmI4Mi03NDNkLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q2eeuMfV48r92-poMbXLDTaGAtD7uDx-_Uz8LE5F9P8=&emci=3275aa84-5539-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=9c25fb82-743d-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801)” concert series Sean T. Connaughton Plaza is back. Prepare to get your hands clapping and your feet moving. The summer concert series will offer a variety of live bands that will provide fun and entertainment for people of all ages. clean_body: | | | July 8th Newsletter Dear neighbors, I hope you had a wonderful 4th of July, celebrating with family and friends! As we reflect on last week's festivities, let's take a moment to remember the history and significance of this important day in American history. Independence Day, also known as the Fourth of July, commemorates the adoption of the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776, declaring the original 13 American colonies as a new nation, the United States of America. The day is often associated with fireworks, parades, barbecues, carnivals, fairs, picnics, concerts, baseball games, family reunions, and ceremonies, as well as various other public and private events celebrating the history, government, and traditions of the United States. | | | This year, much like years in the past, I joined thousands of residents for the annual Dale City parade and family fun day hosted by the Dale City Civic Association. Fun Fact: The nearly 2-mile Dale City parade is believed to be the longest Independence Day parade and arguably the most well-attended in the Commonwealth of Virginia. If you missed this year's parade, there is always next year. The parade has existed for over 50 years and shows no signs of stopping. See you next year! | | As you continue to read this week’s newsletter, you will find the latest updates regarding the , acknowledgment of the history, history, experiences, and achievements of the disability community, new state laws that took effect on July 1st, information regarding the Virginia House of Delegates Page Program, and more. | | Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program | | What is the Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program (VMSDEP)? The program certifies the eligibility of spouses and dependents of veterans to receive tuition waivers at Virginia public educational institutions. is administered jointly by DVS, which processes applications and determines eligibility, and the State Council of Higher Education for Virginia, which distributes stipends to colleges and universities. Therefore, postsecondary institutions cover the full cost of tuition and fees. Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission (JLARC) Study: On Monday, July 1st, the Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission met to receive various presentations. At the end of the meeting, General Assembly members directed JLARC staff to adjust the work program to include an evaluation of all aspects of eligibility criteria and program parameters and back by September 1, 2024. Their findings will include (i) a history of the program; (ii) an analysis of participant data; (iii) validate the waiver costs reported by public higher education institutions; (iv) a review of veteran educational benefits programs in other states and identify best practices; and (v) a review of projections and potential parameters of recommended changes. Legislative Fix & Next Steps: On Tuesday, July 2nd, Senate Finance Chair Louise Lucas and House Appropriations Chairman Luke Torian announced their plan to introduce identical legislation ( and ) to repeal changes to the Virginia Military Survivors and Dependents Education Program in the two-year budget. These changes took effect on Monday. Members of the Senate and the House of Delegates will return to Richmond on July 18 to vote on the agreement. Members of the Virginia House of Delegates and the State Senate will return to Richmond on Thursday, July 18, to pass legislation ensuring a full repeal of May 2024 changes to VMSDEP. May 13, 2024 changes which took effect July 1, 2024: Increased funding by $40 million ($20 million each year of the biennium) Restricted eligibility to associate and undergraduate degrees; Required participants to apply for other forms of financial aid; and Tightened residency requirements. July 18, 2024, bill language: Increases VMSDEP funding by $90 million using FY24 surplus funding ($45 million each year of the biennium on top of the $40 million previously allocated in the 2024 biennial state budget); and Repeals all noted changes from May 2024 listed above. My Continued Commitment: I have spoken with numerous impacted families, many of which call the 25th House District home. While the past few months have been filled with frustration, stress, and anxiety, please find comfort in knowing that I have always stood with our military heroes, first responders, and their families, and will continue to do so. That includes ensuring VMSDEP will continue to be an earned educational benefit for military and veteran families for years to come. Disability Pride Month July is Disability Pride Month, a time to honor and raise awareness about the diversity, history, and culture of the disability community. This month is rooted in the history of the disability rights movement, which advocates for equal rights, accessibility, and inclusion for people with disabilities. The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), which prohibits discrimination against people with disabilities, was signed into law by President George H.W. Bush on July 26, 1990. The first official celebration of Disability Pride Month occurred in July 2015, which also marked the 25th anniversary of the ADA. Disability Pride Month aims to celebrate the accomplishments and contributions of individuals with disabilities while also highlighting the ongoing work needed to break down barriers and promote a more inclusive society. It allows people to come together to recognize the value of every individual, regardless of ability, and to encourage a more equitable and accessible world for all. Held each winter at the historic Virginia State Capitol and General Assembly Building in Richmond, Virginia, the program aims to prepare students for active citizenship. It also provides participants with a firsthand look at the lawmaking process. It's a fantastic opportunity for students to enhance their leadership skills, develop workplace abilities, and contribute to our democracy. Hi Peter,

Our primary was incredibly hard-fought. I know that to win in November, I will need to count on the votes of people who voted for one of the other candidates. In this email, I want to make sure that you know what I stand for—because I believe we have more in common than not.

Across the country, and especially in our region, we are experiencing a profound housing crisis. Safe and affordable housing should be a fundamental right. It will take clear leadership and all of us working together to make that vision a reality. I have a proven track record of delivering on this issue and am determined to accomplish much more in Congress.

These struggles in our community are magnified by the obstacles so many face with addiction and mental health. Growing up in a family deeply impacted by mental health struggles, I understand the massive challenges people face. As a physician, I know how hard it is for my patients to find affordable care. Treatment must be widely accessible and affordable to end the crisis on our streets and give people the chance they deserve to turn their lives around. We can all help by celebrating those who are seeking mental health and substance use disorder care rather than allowing the stigmatization to continue.

Finally, it is long past time Congress takes bold action to tackle climate change. In Oregon, heart disease, stroke, respiratory illness, and cancer rank among the top five causes of death, and the correlation between air pollution and these diseases is undeniable. I will champion a strong clean air policy and double down on a swift transition to 100% renewable energy sources to eliminate our reliance on fossil fuels and improve the health of our citizens.

These are just some of my priorities and values. Stay tuned to my campaign to hear more from me between now and election day in November.

clean_body: | = Hi Peter, Our primary was incredibly hard-fought. I know that to win in November, I will need to count on the votes of people who voted for one of the other candidates. In this email, I want to make sure that you know what I stand for—because I believe we have more in common than not. Across the country, and especially in our region, we are experiencing a profound housing crisis. Safe and affordable housing should be a fundamental right. It will take clear leadership and all of us working together to make that vision a reality. I have a proven track record of delivering on this issue and am determined to accomplish much more in Congress. These struggles in our community are magnified by the obstacles so many face with addiction and mental health. Growing up in a family deeply impacted by mental health struggles, I understand the massive challenges people face. As a physician, I know how hard it is for my patients to find affordable care. Treatment must be widely accessible and affordable to end the crisis on our streets and give people the chance they deserve to turn their lives around. We can all help by celebrating those who are seeking mental health and substance use disorder care rather than allowing the stigmatization to continue. Finally, it is long past time Congress takes bold action to tackle climate change. In Oregon, heart disease, stroke, respiratory illness, and cancer rank among the top five causes of death, and the correlation between air pollution and these diseases is undeniable. I will champion a strong clean air policy and double down on a swift transition to 100% renewable energy sources to eliminate our reliance on fossil fuels and improve the health of our citizens. These are just some of my priorities and values. Dear Peter,
The debate between Presidents Biden and Trump has dramatically altered the political landscape.
Now, I’m not going to join the pile-on regarding President Biden’s debate performance. Nor will I speculate about whether he will remain at the head of the Democratic ticket through the election.
One thing is certain though: _Our country faces a grave crisis in leadership._
It wasn’t just the two men on the stage who were arguing at a third-grade level. Our national politics has descended to that level too.
It wasn’t just me they tried to keep off the debate stage ... [it was all the issues](https://www.kennedy24.com/what-happened-real-debate-donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cleaning_up_7_8_24_nd1&n=5) that the leaders of [both parties are helpless to address](https://www.kennedy24.com/what-happened-real-debate-donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cleaning_up_7_8_24_nd1&n=6) and would therefore rather ignore.

At last count MORE THAN 10 MILLION PEOPLE watched my livestreamed debate performance. I answered the same questions as the other two, in real time. And I brought onto the stage with me THE ISSUES we really need to be talking about.
The corruption in Washington which thrived under both Presidents Biden and Trump.
The widening wealth gap.
The endless wars.
The chronic disease epidemic.
The assault on our rights and freedoms.
The destruction of the middle class.
Those are the issues I’ll address when I make it to Washington, D.C.
This debate has opened a wide door for my candidacy. Millions of voters are repulsed by the choice the Democrats and Republicans put on embarrassing display the week before last.
[I am asking for your financial support right now](https://www.kennedy24.com/what-happened-real-debate-donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cleaning_up_7_8_24_nd1&n=8) so I can surge through that newly opened doorway. This is our moment. History is being made before our eyes.

Our national politics has descended to that level too. It wasn’t just me they tried to keep off the debate stage ... that the leaders of and would therefore rather ignore. Well, they tried to shut me out, but they didn’t succeed. At last count MORE THAN 10 MILLION PEOPLE watched my livestreamed debate performance. I answered the same questions as the other two, in real time. And I brought onto the stage with me THE ISSUES we really need to be talking about. The corruption in Washington which thrived under both Presidents Biden and Trump. The widening wealth gap. The endless wars. The chronic disease epidemic. The assault on our rights and freedoms. The destruction of the middle class. Those are the issues I’ll address when I make it to Washington, D.C. This debate has opened a wide door for my candidacy. Millions of voters are repulsed by the choice the Democrats and Republicans put on embarrassing display the week before last. so I can surge through that newly opened doorway. This is our moment. Team,
Donald Trump has been campaigning heavily in Michigan, visiting 6 times in the last 13 months. Back in May, he used his platform to prop up Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers. In doing so, he attacked Elissa by name, calling her “far-left liberal lunatic Slotkin” and going through a slew of Trumpian lies about what Elissa believes, says, and does.
Once Trump attacked Elissa, it was like the bat signal went out: the floodgates opened and we saw new attack ads on TV, online, in the mail, and of course from individuals on social media.
Now, in order to promote Mike Rogers ahead of his August 6th competitive primary, a dark money super PAC has bought new TV ads across the state using Trump’s “left liberal lunatic” attack to uplift Rogers and drag down Elissa. Take a look:

We’ve done a lot of groundwork to introduce Elissa to voters by airing our own TV ads, knocking doors, and attending events in communities across the state.

Before I ran for office, I was an environmental lawyer. I helped hold big corporations accountable for pollution, oversaw the cleanup of toxic waste sites, and filed an amicus brief in the first Supreme Court case to recognize the effect of greenhouse gasses on climate change. When I got to the Arizona legislature, I knew I could use my experience to tackle our biggest environmental challenges. **And nothing was, or is, more pressing than Arizona’s water security.** I worked with anyone who was willing to come to the table on the Colorado Drought Contingency Plan and fought to ensure all Basin states were doing their fair share. **I spent years in the Arizona legislature working on a solution to protect our water supply, and I'll do the same in Congress.** I’ll hold all Southwest Basin states accountable for conserving water and put an end to Arizona Republicans selling our supply to foreign countries. | | **From The Chairman**
---
| | We now have public imagery of Chinese spying facilities in our backyard, Cuba. As most of us were looking forward to the Fourth of July holiday, the Center for Strategic and International Studies in Washington, D.C. released a [report](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=ef6600443ef74387800c4ecb91ed1d4f&_e=RkrobztOpjkpJADqUdj7NhvAp1PAx2j423CVVH6iNCktvcWRU1wzWdDZcIWtgt92QMN7d99R4qW5kkwXvZbMdGivxGi6FLSy5zD6htftLymZFD6Lb8uPVEwWccoQO6rvwqzSDI1HoNcUDlWJ0zoDA0Yv1NL92bI_UU2-LC-9gqV-O3aXzhVeqvV804MsrhmdlDdyZ1NRfwNI6J5X03L_7D77GlMpYtKyyA4l5m4zv1ar_5Ng61t3MSL2LHgErFxy) that exposed a number of bases all aimed at our sensitive military facilities across the southern United States. These bases—which the Biden administration has [known](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=ef6600443ef74387800c4ecb91ed1d4f&_e=RkrobztOpjkpJADqUdj7Ns_jRCu71yFNHiT-fm342EVyDybazNN-_U7D2FqKzcarDnQ5UnJwFjzxCuZZBXDk4bBtsgelEGOTdMwH2jbHjQDSKvOY1Ap4A-wmEsxMnkYilYIticB4RzIzTqnvV_Jy4QxMOrbW6GGopvJW7dmahcUWQAigfQswnGZ7K_YUBWwHvtpCKDGAGOe5o3wYSlYtH7PJg4TxY41cU6-rzgjDXN8XVacf48Nyki1awMEB-X2IatD2lnRE4nyKS6wt1GHTnZkNgTG3hi3zLnDOxAyAr2ubk-5aSs-MzWI6h13u1WO2) all about for some time—were built, in many cases, on old bases that the Soviet Union and later Russia once operated. Everyone spies, it is a fact of statecraft, but this is cause for growing concern. For one thing, it shows just how close the relationship between Russia and China is getting. You don’t just let anyone use your intelligence facilities. By way of comparison, our closest and deepest intelligence relationship is with the United Kingdom and started during World War Two. These Chinese bases also tell us about Beijing’s growing friendship with Havana and ambitions in the region. The administration is not taking the China threat nearly as seriously as it should, and this is just another example of their misplaced priorities and misplaced attention.

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week:

Last week, I: -Walked in 4th of July parades in Ames, Humboldt, and Sioux City -Spoke at the Story County Democrats Potluck in Ames -Met with a group of Republicans in O'Brien county
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week:

I had a two hour long chat Sunday with a room full of Republicans. Good people. We disagreed on some things but certainly agreed on a lot. Here's the top ten things we agreed on:
1\. The carbon capture pipelines are a scam and an unjustifiable abuse of eminent domain 2\. We need to get corporate money out of politics 3\. We need to address regulatory capture 4\. The persistent population decline and hollowing out of most of our district's communities can and should be prioritized for resolution 5\. We face a big problem with the aging out of our farmers along with the lack of incentives and major barriers to entry that will make it harder to bring in first time farmers to replace them 6\. Per number 5, we need to stop billionaire investors from buying up massive swaths of our farm land (and housing stock) that reduces availability and prices people out. 7\. The attack on public education in our state is really going to hurt small town Iowa 8\. Foreign governments don't have to buy our farmland to own Iowa ag, they just have to buy our politicians via the PAC donations of the companies they own (Smithfield, Syngenta, and Feenstra, for example) 9\. There's waste in government ag subsidy programs we need to root out 10\. Feenstra is a corporate puppet that represents his big moneyed donors instead of them
Our schedule for this week:
-Monday 7/8, I met with the Iowa AARP to discuss the trials and tribulations of family caregivers -Wednesday 7/10, I'll be at the Buena Vista Co Fair Dem Party Booth in the evening -Thursday 7/11, I'll be at the Wright Co Fair with state house candidate Kyle Kruse at his booth -Friday 7/12, I'll be at the Carroll Co Fair Dem Party Booth in the early afternoon before heading out to the Central Iowa Fair in the evening in Marshalltown, where I'll be hanging out with the Marshall Co Dems -Saturday 7/13, I'll be at Omaha/Council Bluffs Pride and am also going to try to make it out to the Mills Co Dem Party fair booth if possible -Sunday 7/14, I'll be at the Pottawattomie Co Dems Fundraiser in Council Bluffs at 1:30 at New Horizon Presbyterian Church
Recent press/social media posts of note:

https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/news/2024/06/28/iowa-supreme-court-lets-6-week-abortion-ban-take-effect-how-iowans-reacted-kim-reynolds/74205895007/
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including:
-Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!

Let's keep fighting the good fight together!
Ryan Melton
